acip: RAB RIB CAN GYI MIG GIS SKRA SHAD SOGS MTHONG BA DANG, BONG BU'I RVA LA SOGS PA MI MTHONG BA'I NGES PA DE'I PHYIR RNAM SMIN YID DU 'ONG BA NI MI DGE BA LAS MI 'BYUNG LA, RNAM SMIN YID DU MI 'ONG BA NI DGE BA LAS MA YIN PA'I PHYIR, RNAM SMIN MI DGE BA STE YID DU MI 'ONG BA NI, NAG PO'I LAS LAS YIN LA, RNAM SMIN DGE BA STE YID DU 'ONG BA NI DGE BA LAS 'BYUNG BA YIN PAR MTHONG ZHING,
english: Eyes affected by cataracts see things like strands of hair; but it is definite that they do not see things like horns on top of the head of a rabbit. As such, it is not the case that a pleasant ripening of karma can come from a non-virtuous deed; and neither can an unpleasant ripening come from a virtuous deed. We can see then that a non-virtuous ripening—an unpleasant one—is something that comes from a black karma; while a virtuous ripening—a pleasant one—is something that comes from a good deed.
